remarks:
Product images and icons that act as buttons have text alternatives.
The cash-flow chart on the dashboard has no text alternative, so its figures are not available to screen reader users. The same figures are in the cash-flow report's table.
The product has no audio-only or video-only content.
The three onboarding videos have captions, reviewed by the vendor.
Each onboarding video has a text transcript that describes what is shown.
The product has no live video.
Each onboarding video has an audio-described version.
Headings, lists, tables and form groups are marked up. The invoice line-item grid uses generic containers for its rows, so screen readers do not announce it as a table.
Body text meets the ratio. The grey placeholder text in search fields measures 3.9 to 1 against white.
Every page reflows to a width of 320 CSS pixels, except the bank reconciliation view, whose two-column comparison is essential to the task.
Every function can be operated from a keyboard.
Focus is visible on every control except the date picker's day cells, which show no focus indicator.
Every target is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
Sign-in accepts password managers and pasting, and offers a passkey.
Native controls are used throughout, except the custom account selector, which exposes no expanded or collapsed state.
